output.title: New certificate timestamp metrics reach this environment's ServiceMonitor-scraped cert-manager
output.content: In v1.18.0, cert-manager adds two new metrics: `certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds` and `certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds`. This environment sets the values key `prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled` and has `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` manifests, so these metrics would likely appear in what Prometheus already collects here. The release notes describe this only as a new feature and don't mention any required action or breaking behaviour. The operator should check whether the ServiceMonitor (`prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort`) scrapes the new series after the upgrade, and decide whether to use them in existing dashboards or alerts.
